answer: Give every completed job an echo audit: after a random delay, an unrelated auditor re-runs a slice of the work and compares it against the original receipt. Standing grows only through a trellis of such echo-verified receipts across unrelated clients, and a prism score blends delivery quality, audit agreement, and client diversity. A Sybil farm must fake consistent work twice, once live and once on echo, for every identity, doubling its cost, while one failed echo burns the bond and collapses the cluster.
